task.description:
Build the new node details panel and the shared relationship list of the Desktop Metaproject explorer as NEW FILES ONLY. Nothing existing is edited and nothing is wired in yet; task T8 does that afterwards.

Create in apps/desktop/src/metaproject/:
1. RelationshipList.tsx - exports `RelationshipList` with the same name and props as the function now exported from MetaprojectView.tsx (lines 228-276), which stays untouched. New behaviour: root-adjacent relationships grouped by direction (Incoming, Outgoing) and then by relationship kind, each group with a heading and a count; a row shows the other node's title, a kind badge and its path, and calls `select(id)`; relationships between two non-root nodes form a separate 'Second step' group whose rows name both ends and can open either; evidence is shown as at most two example lines; provenance digests are not shown; the truncated and empty states keep a clear message.
2. NodeDetailsPanel.tsx - exports `NodeDetailsPanel` and `isOpenSpecNode` with exactly the contract of plan.md, 'Interfaces between tasks'. Structure per plan.md, 'Panel: a summary of the node': header (kind badge, close, title, monospace path with a 'Copy path' control), facts, one tab bar with counts (Relationships, Wiki, OpenSpec; Relationships is the default), tab bodies. The Wiki and OpenSpec tabs carry over the behaviour of GraphNodePanel.tsx: linked documents from the `documents` projection, the suggested component page, preview, Open, Find, Draft and the 'This CLI does not support OpenSpec' message. Also carried over: the resize handle with its keyboard support, Escape to close, and the compact mode below an 820 px host. Differences from GraphNodePanel: (a) docked, the panel does not move focus when it opens; in compact mode it is a right-anchored drawer that leaves part of the content visible, takes focus on open and returns it on close; (b) the preview text is cleaned of Markdown markers (blockquote `>`, `**`, `__`, single `_` or `*` emphasis, backticks, list markers) and skips metadata lines such as 'Covers:', 'Version:', 'Type:', 'Status:'; (c) one primary action per tab body, the rest quiet.
3. nodePanel.css - styles for both, imported by the components, built from the app's tokens and existing shared classes (plan.md, 'Design direction'; context.md, 'What the app already has to build with').
4. NodeDetailsPanel.dom.test.tsx and RelationshipList.dom.test.tsx.

The counts 'N incoming · M outgoing' come from the root-adjacent edges of `relationships` (`edge.to === root` is incoming, `edge.from === root` is outgoing). While `relationships` is null and `relationshipsPending` is true show a loading state; with a non-empty `relationshipsProblem` show the message and a Retry that calls `onRetry`. A change of the `revealRelationships` number switches to the Relationships tab and scrolls it into view.

Use tokens and existing shared classes; add a class only where nothing fits. No raw colour values. Targets at least 24x24 px, visible focus, headings in order (the panel title is an h2).
acceptance_criteria: AC7: `NodeDetailsPanel` shows the selected node's kind as a text badge, its title, its repository path with a "Copy path" control that writes the path to the clipboard, and "N incoming · M outgoing" counts computed from the root-adjacent edges of the `relationships` projection, with "limited" when it is truncated. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/NodeDetailsPanel.dom.test.tsx`]

AC8: Relationships is the default tab and lists root-adjacent relationships grouped by direction and then relationship kind; activating a row calls `onSelect` with that neighbour's id; relationships between two non-root nodes are listed in a separate group whose rows can open either endpoint; a change of `revealRelationships` switches to the Relationships tab. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/NodeDetailsPanel.dom.test.tsx src/metaproject/RelationshipList.dom.test.tsx`]

AC9: A linked-document preview contains no Markdown markers and skips metadata: for a page whose body starts with a `> **Covers:**` blockquote line followed by a prose paragraph, the preview is that prose paragraph with no `>`, `**`, emphasis underscores or backticks. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/NodeDetailsPanel.dom.test.tsx`]

A component's styles live in a sibling .css file it imports; classes are plain BEM-like names prefixed `metaproject-`; colours, spacing, type sizes and radii come only from the tokens in apps/desktop/src/styles/tokens.css. Shared types are imported from ../../../../src/integrations/metaproject-explorer-contract. Tests sit next to the code as *.test.ts (pure) or *.dom.test.tsx (happy-dom).
